articles.summary: The Board of Directors of Southside Bancshares, Inc., (NYSE:SBSI), parent company of Southside Bank declared a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.37 per common share. The cash dividend of $0.37 is scheduled for payment on December 9, 2026, to common stock shareholders of record on November 25, 2026. About Southside Bancshares, Inc. Southside Bancshares, Inc. is a bank holding company headquartered in Tyler, Texas, with approximately $8.87 billion in assets as of September 30, 2026, that wholly-owns Southside Bank. Southside Bank currently operates 55 branches and a network of 71 ATMs/ITMs throughout East Texas, Southeast Texas and the greater Dallas/Fort Worth, Austin and Houston areas. Serving customers since 1960, Southside Bank is a community-focused financial institution that offers a full range of financial products and services to individuals and businesses.
